observed_gap.trigger: Enter/Escape or form submission during IME composition in the layer rename field.
observed_gap.before: The composing candidate could be submitted or the inline edit canceled before the IME committed its final replacement; this was reproduced at 390px and 1366px.
observed_gap.impact: A partial name could enter the Page Model, or the rename editor could close while mobile text composition was still active.

behavior: Prevent Enter and Escape from submitting or canceling while composition is active, including legacy keyCode 229 events.
Reject form submission during composition even if requestSubmit is called directly.
Keep the composition guard active through the next animation frame after compositionend to cover mobile IMEs that deliver the final replacement afterward.
After composition settles, preserve existing trim validation and element.update save behavior.
implementation.reuse_review: Reviewed project-owned IME handling in composition-inputs.js and code-snippet-inspector.js. Those paths do not submit this layer form; the focused guard belongs in the existing form. No external code or dependency added.
implementation.save_publish: The composition guard does not call Save or Publish and preserves their separation.
